properties.name: houtu.client.httpclient.disable-cookie-management
properties.description: Whether to disable HttpClient cookie management.

properties.name: houtu.client.httpclient.pool.max-total
properties.description: Maximum number of connections in the connection pool.

properties.name: houtu.client.httpclient.pool.disable-ssl-validation
properties.description: Whether to trust all certificates and skip hostname verification (test/intranet only).

properties.name: houtu.client.httpclient.pool.pool-reuse-policy
properties.description: Connection pool reuse policy (LIFO or FIFO).

properties.name: houtu.client.httpclient.pool.pool-concurrency-policy
properties.description: Connection pool concurrency policy (STRICT or LAX).

properties.name: houtu.client.httpclient.pool.time-to-live
properties.description: Maximum time-to-live of a pooled connection.

properties.name: houtu.client.httpclient.pool.validate-after-inactivity
properties.description: Re-validate a pooled connection before reuse after this period of inactivity.

properties.name: houtu.client.httpclient.pool.evict-expired-connections
properties.description: Whether to evict expired connections from the pool.

properties.name: houtu.client.httpclient.pool.evict-idle-time
properties.description: Evict connections idle longer than this duration (disabled when not set).

properties.name: houtu.client.httpclient.request.connect-timeout
properties.description: Connection establishment timeout; falls back to spring.http.client.connect-timeout when not set.

properties.name: houtu.client.httpclient.request.read-timeout
properties.description: Socket read timeout (SO_TIMEOUT); falls back to spring.http.client.read-timeout when not set.

properties.name: houtu.client.httpclient.request.redirects-enabled
properties.description: Whether to follow redirects; falls back to spring.http.client.redirects when not set.
